premise.claim: Issue #6275: "InjectNodeSelectorRequirements loops with `for _, nodeSelectorTerm := range ...NodeSelectorTerms` and appends to the loop variable, which is a copy, so the new requirements are thrown away. It only works when the operation has no required node affinity at all. If a DataLoad, DataMigrate or DataProcess already sets spec.affinity.nodeAffinity.requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution, the requirement that runAfter.affinityStrategy (policy: Require ...) asks for is never added to its pod."
premise.reportedComponent: pkg/utils/affinity.go InjectNodeSelectorRequirements, reached via pkg/dataflow InjectAffinityByRunAfterOp
